globalStyle.camera: Locked-off static shot, vertical. A medium-wide shot exactly like the reference frame: he is STANDING in the middle of the frame, framed from mid-thigh up and fairly small in the frame, so his body fills only about the middle half of the frame width with wide empty backdrop on BOTH sides of him; his shoulders, elbows and hands always stay well inside the frame; clear space above his head. Eye level, natural portrait-lens look, no zoom, no pan, no camera movement; the camera itself is never visible
globalStyle.realism: Photorealistic live-action footage of a real human presenter recorded in one studio session against a plain ivory backdrop, NOT a furnished room. Soft, bright, even high-key light: a soft frontal key light on his face with soft fill, no harsh shadows, natural skin texture, natural eye contact straight into the lens and accurate lip sync, identical exposure and white balance in every scene. TRUE-TO-LIFE BODY: natural adult proportions that match his face - broad shoulders, a solid average build that fills the jacket (not slim, not lanky), and SLENDER, NATURAL-SIZE HANDS: each hand no longer than his face, relaxed fingers held close together, never spread wide, hands never closer to the camera than his chest
globalStyle.delivery: Highly energetic, enthusiastic legal trainer leading a masterclass for advocates, like a motivating coach talking straight to camera: bright smile, lively eyes, confident emphasis on key words, brisk clear pace, a tiny pause after each full stop; speak the dialogue exactly once, word for word, never repeat, stretch or slow down a word, never add words
